literal_meaning: হাত-দাঁত-মুখ ব্যবহার করে লড়াই (hands, teeth, and mouth in combat)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই দলের মধ্যে হদ্দমুদ্দ লড়াই শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A fierce fight has broken out between the two teams.
The political parties are engaged in an intense battle.
note: This idiom depicts a desperate, all-encompassing fight, possibly originating from rural or colloquial Bengali expressions for physical confrontations.
